Definition: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
BiblicalUsage: Peh is the mouth, and Scripture treats it as the gate of the whole life. God asked Moses, “Who hath made man's mouth?” — the same mouth He opened in Balaam's ass to speak, and the same mouth He touched in Jeremiah to put His words in it. The psalm prays that the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart would be acceptable to God.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that the mouth reveals the heart, and God claims both: He made the mouth, He opens it, He fills it, and He judges what comes out of it. That is why I pray the psalm's prayer every morning — that what I say would be acceptable in His sight, because my words are never just words. They are the overflow of what I believe, and they will be weighed.
